main.tex:thm:finite-projective-group.reason: The hypotheses are detection of each pure Z operator, not all weight-one errors. ZDetectionHypothesis supplies finite_intrinsicGroup_of_zDetects and the nonidentity primitive-lift package under exactly this hypothesis; BetaExists supplies its finite bound. The abelian quotient holds independently. The lift package carries m dividing q, and HasPrimitiveLift retains a primitive numerator and the physical representative. The older whole_of_finite requires d >= 2 and is deliberately not used as the sole justification.

main.tex:thm:general-sslp-normal-form.reason: The existing forward theorem retains the original projective class and the actual local-X/physical-permutation frame transport, sorted primitive angles, colors, multiplicities, fibers and distance. The new paper-facing converse takes arbitrary subspaces with the manuscript dimensions and full computational-basis fiber containments. Euclidean orthonormal bases are transported back to the original state type; each chosen sector spans exactly the supplied subspace. Distinct colors imply orthogonality and independence, not additional assumptions. The assembled frame spans their supremum, has dimension K, and satisfies the full KL predicate from basis-independent scalar compression for all Pauli weights strictly below d. The d=0 boundary follows from the identity Pauli and frame orthonormality, avoiding a hidden positive-distance restriction. The final ExactCode retains that same span, the literal finite diagonal gate with angle a, and an intrinsic class of exact order m. The zero color is a designated finite index; including it in the gcd does not change the gcd of the other colors. No supplied frame or assumed directness remains.

main.tex:cor:rank-two-sslp.reason: rank_two_sslp assumes precisely a nontrivial intrinsic diagonal group and d >= 2. It gives cyclicity, finiteness and a sorted normal form with m equal to the full group cardinality, both residues, primitivity, and explicit X/permutation transport of the code. rank_two_sslp_converse supplies the reverse implication for the actual orthonormal supported pair at arbitrary length. This normal form selects the generator after the allowed unit-power normalization; zero amplitudes are allowed by the support predicate.

main.tex:lem:phase-sectors.reason: phaseSectors_of_zDetects and PhaseSectorFull use Z detection alone. sectorProbability is the diagonal sector projector divided by positive rank; its support is the strictly-positive locus. main.tex:thm:colored-finite-lift.reason: The single combined theorem assumes only single-site Z detection, an actual diagonal symmetry, its real-angle representative and nontrivial intrinsic class. Its spectral resolution is the canonical one, so ell is the actual number of distinct logical eigenvalues, not an unrelated existential sector count. It chooses one nonsingular pivot P of the colored matrix and uses L=P.rationalLift throughout. Its zero-one partner uses the same rows and columns. The literal binary solution solves the selected integral-right-hand-side system, and undoing column signs and extending by zero gives exactly L.augmented. An actual normalized Smith witness W is constructed for that binary matrix, with L.order dividing W.lastFactor. The same L gives the primitive modular angle and actual symmetry in the original intrinsic class; its projective order divides L.order. The bound s<=n+ell-1, the Smith-factor beta bound and ell<=K all occur in the same conclusion. An attained minimum over HasPrimitiveLift is bounded by this very L.order and hence beta_(n+ell-1). There is no supplied pivot/Smith witness, stronger distance assumption, or separately chosen physical lift. The root uses the existing repository constructions rather than re-proving Smith existence or rationalization.
